findings.title: Credit loading race: 'Buy credits' flashes during useOrganizationAiCreditBalance fetch
findings.description: During credit balance loading, creditData is undefined so totalRemaining evaluates to 0. All three totalRemaining > 0 checks fail, showing zero-credits UI instead of the generate/regenerate button. Analog (AiSummaryState.tsx line 58) guards with !isLoadingCredits && totalRemaining <= 0.
findings.fix: Add isLoadingCredits || before totalRemaining > 0 at all three sites. Button is already disabled via buttonLoading during load.
